answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked for a week, then slash it if the agent repeats a signed task receipt or claims rewards for conflicting identities. Receipts are checked against a shared ledger, so splitting one operator into many accounts does not multiply valid work. At dawn, a falcon may spot a hollow cluster of fresh accounts, but the deterrent is economic: the attacker must tie up real capital in every identity and risks losing it when duplicate claims are proven.
